tools.name: extract_clean_markdown
tools.description: Converts raw HTML pages or live web URLs into clean, boilerplate-free, LLM-optimized Markdown with preserved hyperlinks and headings. Accepts either 'url' to fetch directly or raw 'html_content' from upstream scrape_readable_article; for isolating tabular data into structured datasets, use parse_htm

tools.name: scrape_readable_article
tools.description: Fetches any public HTTP/HTTPS URL and extracts article text, headings, author bylines, and raw html_content. Use as the universal URL fetcher before downstream HTML parsing tools (parse_html_tables, isolate_css_selectors, extract_clean_markdown); for converting full raw HTML without fetching, pass h

tools.name: extract_structured_metadata
tools.description: Extracts OpenGraph tags, Twitter Card metadata, canonical URLs, and Schema.org JSON-LD microdata scripts from live URLs or raw HTML. Accepts either 'url' to fetch directly or raw 'html_content' from upstream scrape_readable_article; for extracting contact emails and phone numbers, use extract_contac

tools.name: parse_html_tables
tools.description: Detects and parses HTML table elements from live URLs or raw HTML into structured JSON record arrays and GitHub-Flavored Markdown tabular grids. Accepts either 'url' to fetch directly or raw 'html_content' from upstream scrape_readable_article; for extracting full article body text, use scrape_reada

tools.name: isolate_css_selectors
tools.description: Evaluates CSS selector queries against live URLs or raw HTML DOM trees to extract targeted inner text, outer HTML, or element attributes. Accepts either 'url' to fetch directly or raw 'html_content' from upstream scrape_readable_article; for parsing complete table matrices into JSON, use parse_html_

tools.name: detect_paywall_and_bypass
tools.description: Audits web page DOM hierarchies to detect soft paywalls, blur overlays, modal gates, and recovers concealed body text. Use when diagnosing paywall obstructions, diagnosing subscriber gating scripts, or auditing content access barriers; for assessing general SEO hygiene, use evaluate_seo_diagnostics

tools.name: crawl_sitemap_urls
tools.description: Parses XML sitemaps and sitemap index files into structured URL trees with change frequency and last-modified filters. Use when discovering domain architectures, mapping crawl frontiers, or indexing blog/product catalogues; for extracting on-page hyperlinks from raw HTML, use extract_page_hyperlinks

tools.name: extract_page_hyperlinks
tools.description: Extracts, normalizes, and filters internal and external hyperlinks, anchor texts, and downloadable asset targets from HTML. Use when building site crawlers, auditing broken links, or extracting reference citations; for isolating primary readable article narrative text, use scrape_readable_article in

tools.name: sanitize_html_content
tools.description: Sanitizes raw HTML or live URLs by removing malicious script tags, iframes, inline event handlers, and data URIs into safe markup. Accepts either 'url' to fetch directly or raw 'html_content' from upstream scrape_readable_article; for converting clean HTML into markdown, use extract_clean_markdown i

tools.name: extract_contact_info
tools.description: Extracts email addresses, telephone numbers, physical addresses, and social network handles from web text and DOM footers. Use when researching sales leads, aggregating business contact directories, or extracting customer service info; for parsing structured tabular data, use parse_html_tables inste

tools.name: evaluate_seo_diagnostics
tools.description: Audits HTML heading structures, title lengths, meta descriptions, image alt tags, and OpenGraph compliance into a health score. Use when auditing landing pages, verifying SEO compliance before publishing, or evaluating crawl friendliness; for extracting article bodies, use scrape_readable_article in

tools.name: compile_rss_feed
tools.description: Transforms JSON item collections or article card arrays into standardized RSS 2.0, Atom 1.0, or JSON Feed 1.1 syndication feeds. Use when syndicating blog articles, product announcements, or changelog cards to RSS readers and AI agents; for compiling structured sitemap listings, use crawl_sitemap_ur

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web-scraping-engine" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_clean_markdown, scrape_readable_article, extract_structured_metadata, parse_html_tables, isolate_css_selectors, detect_paywall_and_bypass, crawl_sitemap_urls, extract_page_hyperlinks, sanitize_html_content, extract_contact_info, evaluate_seo_diagnostics, compile_rss_feed · Private data: extract_structured_metadata, parse_html_tables, crawl_sitemap_urls, extract_contact_info · Public sink: extract_contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_clean_markdown, scrape_readable_article, extract_structured_metadata, parse_html_tables, isolate_css_selectors, detect_paywall_and_bypass, crawl_sitemap_urls, extract_page_hyperlinks, sanitize_html_content, extract_contact_info, evaluate_seo_diagnostics, compile_rss_feed · Private data: extract_structured_metadata, parse_html_tables, crawl_sitemap_urls, extract_contact_info · Public sink: extract_contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
